posts.body:
Ghosts of the Titanic
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
This is it.
This is
the official
Ghosts of the Titanic game the world has been waiting for... ah, who are we kidding? This game is a joke.
Seriously.
Uninitiated Gaming created Ghosts of the Titanic in an effort to learn how to use RPG Maker MZ and a variety of plugins, whose developers will not likely wish to include this game in their list of accolades.
I hesitated to share this here, since it's mainly a goof and I only ever uploaded it on itch to make it easy to share with friends, but since it's out there now, I figured I'd share it here. I think at least one or two of you will enjoy it!
----------------------------------------------------
In Ghosts of the Titanic, you play as the scientist Jack Qeuestoh and the explorer Steve Zizzoo. Together, they have been commissioned to scoure the wreckage of the Titanic to find the mysterious violet diamond so strongly desired by their benefactor, Viktor Heinz.
However, when Jack and Steve reach the bottom of the ocean, they meet more than they could have ever expected. Instead of a docile, rusty ship, they find a lively environment inhabited by strange, ghastly beings.
Things only get stranger from there...
----------------------------------------------------
Ghosts of the Titanic is a comedy game that makes use of real names (whose characters are in no way representative of their namesakes) and
might
be pushing the boundaries of Fair Use Doctrine, so it's completely free. That and it's really not worth charging for it; the 2-3 hours of time you'll never get back by playing this game from start to finish is payment enough.
----------------------------------------------------
This project is inspired by a slightly drunken "podcast" recording by the developer and his wife (this is included in the download). To pass time during a long power outage, they lit some candles, poured some whiskey, and took out a phone to record themselves discussing the riveting premise of "what if there are ghosts on the titanic?"
The premise started out as a SyFy B-movie. Then, it grew into an emboldened vision of an ethereal A24 film (see the aforementioned whiskey to understand how they got here), and has now been severely downgraded into its current inception: An RPG game made to learn an engine and make stupid jokes.
You'll probably enjoy it, honestly. It's quite funny and clever at times.
Thanks for playing if you do, and hats off to you if you don't.
----------------------------------------------------
We did our best to give credit to all plugin developers, artists, composers, and other external sources used in the creation of this project. Any omissions are an error on our part and not done in malice. If we missed giving credit to someone, please let us know and we'll correct the error.
